lines.trans: Chef, I have big problems.
What happened in the kitchen again?
I urgently need a good assistant.
Why are you not working alone?
I alone will not manage today.
Do you have too much work?
A very big banquet order arrived.
What exactly needs to be prepared?
Fresh croissants and a big cake.
Max will work with you.
But he does not know how to do anything.
He will peel and cut.
Fine, let him wash the dishes.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

examples.text: На завтрак были кофе и круассаны.
examples.trans: There was coffee and croissants for breakfast.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
as a reply on its own

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job
agrees in gender and case with the noun

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
I urgently need a good assistant.

meanings.en: dishes, plates and cups, tableware (collective singular)
meanings.note: мыть посуду = to wash the dishes

examples.trans: Get up and go wash the dishes!
Clean tableware is on the table.
Why are we going so slowly?

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build
работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

meanings.en: to cut, to slice, to carve

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

справиться.gloss: to manage, to cope, to handle

meanings.note: often + с + instrumental, or used absolutely

examples.text: Мы за два года тут не справимся.
examples.trans: We won't manage here in two years.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

уметь.gloss: to know how to, to be able to

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
